images.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one exceptional high fidelity desktop screenshot of ApplyFlow, a job application app redesigned as an experimental editorial productivity tool. Landscape 1536x1024. Flat screen filling canvas, no device, no perspective. Strict art direction: graphite black #111110, subtle charcoal #1b1b18, warm ivory #eeece4, restrained pale amber #dfba78; absolutely no blue/cyan/purple anywhere. Experimental finesse from oversized restrained editorial typography, hairline rules, generous asymmetric negative space, monochrome subtle light interference. Avoid standard SaaS dashboards, left sidebars, card grids, icons in squares, glass card stacks, metrics panels, bright gradients, generic corporate illustrations. Layout very simple and usable, primary information easily readable; one prominent primary action per screen. Mostly flat surfaces, understated 8px radius controls. Type mix elegant large modern sans Chinese heading and tiny spaced mono English annotations, sans readable interface. One consistent slim top navigation: left small ApplyFlow wordmark, center only 新申请 / 我的申请, far right small text Alex with down chevron; no extra permanent menus, notifications or search toolbar. Small footer bottom left CONCEPT 02 / 演示数据. Accurate short Chinese labels with restrained English company names. High fashion digital product meets contemporary creative software, polished, deliberate and genuinely minimal, not a marketing website. Reference texture concept: very fine concentric arcs of light sliced by a diagonal grid, monochrome warm silver/amber on near-black, inspired by an optical diffraction shader, low brightness and only in negative space away from text. No actual shader code, deliver a static concept screenshot. SCREEN 1: a working new application entry, active 新申请. Main composition at x160 y220, small 01 / START label; big beautifully spaced title 下一份工作， then second line 从这里开始。, subline 粘贴职位描述，先看清要求，再决定下一步。 One wide almost-black textarea with subtle hairline border below, readable label 职位描述 and ghost text 在这里粘贴 JD…; unobtrusive text 在分析前，你可以随时编辑。 Under textarea one ivory filled primary button 分析这个职位 → and understated text link 仅保存. Discreet line 使用我的 API · 已连接 with small neutral circle, not loud badges. Textarea and action left occupy 65% width, quiet cropped abstract light-ripple concentric arcs inhabit far right 25%, amber monochrome very thin diagonal broken lines, fading into black never behind form. Bottom shows a single restrained continuation row 最近保存 / Northstar · Backend Engineer / 继续 → rather than cards. Sparse and purposeful, no statistics, no welcome dashboard, no form fields beyond JD. Show interface as setup complete; no onboarding checklist.
